title: PMB-NN: Physiological-Model-Based Neural Network for Glucose Forecasting in Type 1 Diabetes
abstract: arXiv:2610.15456v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate, physiologically consistent glucose forecasts could help people with type 1 diabetes respond to impending excursions. We applied our physiological-model-based neural network (PMB--NN) framework to glucose forecasting. A temporal convolutional network (TCN) used 180 min of history, constrained during training by a personalized four-parameter physiological model. The main PMB--NN combined forecast and neural--physiological agreement losses; a three-term variant additionally fitted physiological predictions to measured glucose. Data comprised 6--8 weeks of continuous glucose monitoring, pump, and meal records from 25 AZT1D participants. Person-specific models used chronological 70/10/20 train/validation/test splits and 30-, 60-, and 120-min horizons. translated_title: PMB-NN：基于生理模型的神经网络用于1型糖尿病的血糖预测
translated_abstract: 准确且符合生理一致性的血糖预测可以帮助1型糖尿病患者对即将发生的血糖波动做出应对。我们将基于生理模型的神经网络（PMB-NN）框架应用于血糖预测。时间卷积网络（TCN）使用180分钟的历史数据，并在训练过程中受到个性化四参数生理模型的约束。主要的PMB-NN结合了预测损失和神经-生理一致性损失；一个三项变体还额外将生理预测拟合到实测血糖值上。数据包括25名AZT1D参与者6-8周的连续血糖监测、胰岛素泵和饮食记录。个体化模型采用按时间顺序的70/10/20训练/验证/测试划分，预测时间范围为30、60和120分钟。在使用基础胰岛素记录的情况下，平均绝对误差中位数分别为16.24、25.00和30.20 mg/dL；在这些记录可用之前，分别为15.38、24.21和31.79 mg/dL。（注：原文摘要在末尾处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于生理模型的神经网络框架（PMB-NN），利用个性化四参数生理模型约束时间卷积网络的训练，实现了1型糖尿病患者30至120分钟时间范围内的准确血糖预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a physiological-model-based neural network (PMB-NN) framework that constrains a temporal convolutional network with a personalized four-parameter physiological model, enabling accurate glucose forecasting at 30-, 60-, and 120-minute horizons for people with type 1 diabetes.
